Plot a report of aligned panels

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/plotReport.R
plotReport.Rd

plotReport() stacks tempoPlot panels over a shared time axis for one subject, a cohort or an intervention.

plotReport(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'SummarizedExperiment'
plotReport(
  x,
  time.col,
  group,
  y = NULL,
  level = c("subject", "cohort", "intervention"),
  subject = NULL,
  group.by = NULL,
  assay.type = NULL,
  rank = NULL,
  top = 5,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

a SummarizedExperiment object.

...

additional arguments passed to patchwork::wrap_plots.

time.col

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that contains sampling times: numeric, Date or a factor of visits.

group

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) that identifies subjects.

y

Character vector. Variables drawn as trends, one panel each: columns of colData(x), features of assay.type or "<dimred>:<component>". (Default: NULL)

level

Character scalar. Draws one subject ("subject"): its trends and composition; a cohort ("cohort"): the sampling timeline, boxes of the trends at each time and the mean composition; or an intervention ("intervention"): the change of the trends from each subject's first sample with the mean of each group.by group, and the mean composition of each group. (Default: "subject")

subject

Character scalar. The subject drawn with level = "subject". (Default: NULL)

group.by

Character scalar. Specifies the column from colData(x) with the arm of each subject, needed for level = "intervention". (Default: NULL)

assay.type

Character scalar. Specifies the assay of abundances for the composition, and of features in y. (Default: NULL, the first assay)

rank

Character scalar. Specifies the column of rowData(x) whose levels are summed in the composition. (Default: NULL)

top

Integer scalar. Number of features shown in the composition; the rest are summed into "Other". (Default: 5)

Value

A patchwork object.

Details

Requires patchwork. The panels are plotSwimmer, plotTrend and plotComposition; build other combinations by adding their plots with patchwork.

Examples

# One bioreactor: short-chain fatty acids and species
data("minimalgut", package = "miaTime")
plotReport(minimalgut, time.col = "Time_hr_num",
    group = "StudyIdentifier", y = c("Acetate", "Butyrate"),
    subject = "Bioreactor A", top = 8)


# All bioreactors
plotReport(minimalgut, time.col = "Time_hr_num",
    group = "StudyIdentifier", y = "Acetate", level = "cohort", top = 8)
